description: Spec §27 scenario. Each case: reset the simulated platform, the engineer describes the problem to the agent, an operator runs tools on the case, then the case is resolved with an outcome note. Cases 1-3 share a pattern that Hindsight should consolidate into one observation. The noise case must be skipped by the Memory Writer (rule R1).

cases.name: case-1
messages: Customers report payments stuck in Pending for about 10 minutes. What should I check?
cases.resolve_note: Root cause: the Kafka payment-events consumer had stopped processing payment events (state stalled, lag 1840). Retrying a payment failed because the original request was still pending. Restarting the payment consumer restored processing and all pending payments completed.

cases.name: case-2
messages: Payment Pending alerts firing again in production, several payments not completing.
cases.resolve_note: Same symptoms as before: payment-events consumer stalled with growing lag. Restarting the consumer resolved it; pending payments completed within a minute.

cases.name: case-3
messages: We have payments in Pending status that are not moving. Lag alert on the payments topic too.
cases.resolve_note: Payment-events consumer stalled again. Restart of the consumer fixed it; no pending payments remain.

new_session_question: We have another Payment Pending incident. What should we investigate first?
